meta.executed: Exact-source validation covered the P2 repair paths and all shipped examples using Biopython 1.88, scikit-bio 0.7.3, R ape 5.8.1 and phangorn 2.12.1. The completed nine-input synthetic tree regressions are preserved in runs_v2.
meta.execution_note: Current main already contained the audit P2 repairs. This pass fixed the remaining frontmatter-schema P1, then validated the exact commit. New exact evidence is runs_v3; runs_v2 remains the full synthetic tree regression corpus. FastME CLI and DAMBE are unavailable in this Windows environment.

scientific_integrity.detail: Distance correction, saturation and compositional-heterogeneity limits are explicit; bootstrap is correctly framed as precision rather than accuracy.

methodological_ground.detail: The primary saturation proxy is executable; Xia is optional. UPGMA is refused without a clock and LogDet is routed for composition heterogeneity.

code_usability.detail: Canonical validator passes. Exact-source examples cover gap filtering, gamma estimation, method-reused bootstrap, rooted consensus and known-tree RF checks.

functional_suitability.note: Corrected-matrix hand-off, gamma estimation, gap handling, saturation and method routing are actionable.

reliability.note: Seeded bootstrap, NaN fallback, rooted consensus and explicit gap filtering are present.

performance_context.note: Primary skill is compact and example data are intentionally small.

agent_usability.note: The primary ape proxy and optional Xia language now agree across sections.

human_usability.note: Task routing and concrete warnings are clear.

security.note: Local files only; R output is explicitly sent to tempdir.

maintainability.note: Shipped simulated data and true tree make examples checkable; external specialist CLI coverage remains environment-limited.

agent_specific.note: Supported metadata schema validates; scope and non-goals are explicit.
